description: This site is for those of you who are passionate and intrigued by electricity.  If you read books, Google videos, read magazines, talk to engineers, join forums, and sit at home and tinker on your time off.  This site is for you.  If you want to know how this stuff works, why it acts the way it does, and how to experiment with it on your own time to learn a more profound understanding of it.  This site is for you.
